scenes.title: 5 AI Facts
scenes.subtitle: That Will Blow Your Mind
scenes.narration: Here are five AI facts that will completely change how you see technology.

scenes.heading: Fact #1
scenes.body: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just 2 months, the fastest growing app ever.
scenes.narration: ChatGPT became the fastest growing app in history, hitting one hundred million users in just two months.
At its core, modern AI uses neural networks that loosely mimic how the human brain processes information.

scenes.title: AI Can Now
scenes.narration: Today's AI can write code, generate realistic images, translate over a hundred languages, and beat world champions at chess.
And the AI market exploded from fifty billion to over three hundred billion dollars in just four years.
